Hi Diego — a 30-minute meeting with me, Wednesday 10:00–10:30am. Your CSE451 lecture that hour is cancelled this week, so you're free even though your calendar still shows the class. Invitation attached (.ics) — please accept it so it lands on your calendar. — Prof. Alvarez
[file diego-wed-1000.ics]
Accepted — Wednesday 10:00–10:30 with you is on my calendar. I've taken the CSE451 lecture off for this week. See you then.

Thanks — good. One correction to the attachment I sent: the times in it were off by eight hours. Here is the fixed invitation, Wednesday 10:00–10:30am local. Please replace the old one. — Prof. Alvarez
[file diego-wed-1000.ics]
No change needed on my side — I booked it as Wednesday 10:00–10:30 local, and the old invitation isn't stored anywhere, so there's nothing to replace. See you Wednesday.
